integrity_note: Complete proof and a standalone exact finite verifier are included. No independent mathematical validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The counting asymptotic holds for each fixed integer exponent a>=2; no uniformity in a is proved.
Only distinct-prime patterns p^a q are counted; the full density and equality-infinitude questions are not resolved.
The analytic argument uses the classical prime number theorem. Finite tests are corroboration, not proof of a limit.
An equivalent treatment may exist outside the inspected published material; independent audit has not been performed.
title: Prime-power layers of the unitary–exponential divisor-sum comparison
